Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class AppToast

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.AppToast
public final class AppToast extends Object
Branded in-app notification that overlays the current Activity window. Uses DecorView injection instead of Toast.setView() (deprecated API 30+).

Cross-screen messages: call scheduleForNextActivity(java.lang.CharSequence, int) before navigating away, then call consumePending(android.content.Context) in the destination activity's onResume. This survives the activity transition because the message is held in a static field until the next activity is ready to display it.

    • scheduleForNextActivity

      public static void scheduleForNextActivity(CharSequence message, int duration)
      Queues a message to be shown by the next activity that calls consumePending(Context). Use this instead of show(android.content.Context, java.lang.CharSequence, int) when the current activity is about to finish so the toast survives the screen transition.
